title_suffix: reviewed closeout and localized worker status
summary: OSpec 1.8.16 fixes the remaining Goal archive blockers after verification closeout. A later authoritative APPROVED task review may bind an exact current target state without replacing the dispatch meaningful-change chain, and worker-status sync now updates Combined review sections and checklists across all shipped languages.
new: Added path-specific final-state authorization through a later fully validated task-review snapshot.
Added localized visible status synchronization for worker-status closeout sections.
improved: Keeps dispatch documentation evidence immutable while allowing independently reviewed controller closeout metadata.
Recognizes Combined review checklist text in English, Chinese, Japanese, and Arabic.
Clarifies that the unknown-capacity implementation cap of two is a replaceable safety fallback rather than a global or review concurrency limit.
Skips per-commit file-history scans when local structured release metadata is already complete.
fixed: Fixed verification.md closeout metadata being rejected even when a fresh authoritative task review exactly covered the current file.
Fixed localized Combined review checkboxes remaining unchecked after ospec execute sync.
Fixed visible worker-status section states remaining PENDING after authoritative statuses reached terminal values.
docs: Documented the AIHub post-1.8.15 closeout incident, strict review-snapshot fallback conditions, localized sync behavior, and no-replay recovery path.
